scene black
The next few hours go by so quickly it’s like they never happened in the first place.
And, you know...maybe they didn’t.
But as I step back outside to get on with the rest of the night, I imagine a world in which they did.
And then I think about how many people I’d need to hurt in order to get there.
scene clearnightsky

As I mentioned in the very beginning, there was no way this trip was going to end without some semblance of seriousness. And with the sun merely hours away from rising, it appears I can no longer avoid that.
The two of us move through a maze of white beach chairs and brightly colored umbrellas to an opening halfway between pools number four and five.
I didn’t understand how they were numbered earlier, but it didn’t take very long to figure out once I had a little more time to focus on them.
It’s like that for most things, I find.
Everything is confusing at first — from the way the body works to the manner in which moonlight can reflect off of nearly everything it touches.

Granted, both of those things would likely still confuse me if you were to sit down and carefully explain them, but what I’m trying to say is there will always be aspects of life that just don’t click for us.
For me, the most glaring issue of all is figuring out a way to circumvent how I really feel and properly disguise myself as a good person.
For Maki, the problem is much simpler.
She just doesn’t give herself enough credit.
And if I had to take a guess, it would be that this has something to do with that as well.
scene makiclearnight1
Or...maybe I’m wrong.
That’s not the look of someone who’s battling depressing inner-turmoil or...questioning the methods they’ve used to navigate through mazes far more complex than ones full of chairs and parasols.
To be honest, I don’t really know what that look is.
And for someone who spends so much time deciding how people feel before they’re able to tell me, that’s a little surprising.
Again, it’s only a matter of hours until the sun begins to rise — and that’s not enough time to learn everything there is to know about Maki.
But it’s enough to figure out whatever it is that infiltrated her mind and planted itself within her most identifiable quality.
I just don’t like watching her rot from the inside out, and if there is something I can do to stop it-
: Have you noticed anything different about Makoto lately?
I might have to just look the other way.
: Something tells me we've been here before.
: Something tells me you're right.
: Maki, I’m not really sure I should be getting any further involved in anything that goes on between you and Makoto. It never really goes the way we want it to.
: Not even if it’s good this time?
: What do you mean?
: I’m talking about how she’s been pretty great lately. She’s not sulking or sleeping in or anything like that. She seems to be genuinely enjoying herself.
Or at least doing an exceptional job of pretending to.
: If...that’s what you’re talking about, then yes. I have noticed. I can’t imagine that’s what you called me out here to talk about, though.
scene makiclearnight2
: It is and it isn’t.
: It’s no secret that I may have sidelined my own feelings when my husband died so Makoto wouldn’t be completely without a parental figure, but...
: Now that she’s fine...I don’t know. Maybe all those feelings I didn’t have time to feel are catching up to me or something. There’s a lot going on, but none of it is really bad.
: I’m just confused, I guess. About where to go from here and who I’m supposed to be and what I’m supposed to feel or...do.
: So...are you saying stress or...grief or something really is what’s making you all...non-Maki?
: It’s definitely not helping, I’ll tell you that much.
scene clearnightsky
: Despite how it might seem basically all the time, I am an adult at the end of the day. And I can figure out ways to deal with stress and all that other lame adult stuff.
: I’ve been stressed plenty of times in my life, and it’s never had this effect on me before. But...
: There’s been something bothering me lately. Something that I’ve never had to deal with. And, despite all of the experience in the world, I have no idea what to do about it.
: And that is...somehow centered around Makoto’s happiness?
scene makiclearnight3
: I know it probably sounds weird, but...yeah.
: She’s never been this happy before. And the timing of it all is just really confusing to me since her dad hasn’t even been gone all that long.
: Like, I’m not hoping she goes back to being miserable. I’m over the moon that she can get out of bed on her own now. I just think there’s...something else to this.
: I know her well enough to understand that there’s no way this level of glee would ever come naturally. And so...I think there’s something else that’s making her happy.
: Why not just accept whatever that is, then? There’s no need to bash your head against the wall trying to figure it out when you should just be happy for her.
: What I’m saying is I think she’s having sex.
: At the very least, she probably has a boyfriend or something. But the weirdest part of all of it is that I, Maki Miyamura, the sex queen of the city-
: Have absolutely no idea how to talk to her about it...
: It’s crazy, isn’t it? You’d think that if anyone could talk to their daughter about this, it would be me. I even had a dry run during that Dorm Wars thingy.
: I’ve been preparing for it for...basically forever since I knew this day would come.
: But now that it’s here...I’m lost. I have no idea what to say to her. I feel totally useless in my very own area of expertise.
: Now, any time I think about sex at all, I just start thinking about her. And I’m sure I don’t have to tell you why that hasn’t really been working out for me.
: You want to weigh in on this at all or should I just keep ranting? Because you should at least be slightly invested in this as her teacher.
: Why...do you think she’s having sex?
: Well, between the constant excitement, her better attitude toward me, and the huge box of condoms I found in her room, I’ve just got a pretty good idea. Call it mother’s intuition.
: I see...
: I had no idea she even knew any boys. Like, where would she even find one?
: I have no idea, Maki...
scene makiclearnight4
: Do you get why I’ve been weird lately, now? Or does this still sound all sorts of ridiculous to you? Because it sounds kind of ridiculous to me and I’m smack-dab in the middle of it.
: I...don’t really know how it sounds. And I probably shouldn’t be weighing in on this.
scene makiclearnight5

: That’s it, then? You’re just going to blue ball me in the advice department again because it makes you uncomfortable? How the hell do you think I feel? This is my teenage daughter we’re talking about.
: Makoto’s smart. You probably don’t need to talk to her about anything if you don’t want to.
: Makoto is smart, yes. But she’s also a child. And for all we know, there could be some older dude who swooped in to take advantage of her in a time of weakness or something.
: That stuff doesn’t just happen in porn, you know. It happens in real life every single day and, most of the time, we have no idea until it’s already too late.
What I want to say is that continuing to not do anything is the exact way things become “too late” in the first place...
But I obviously can’t — because I’m the man she’s talking about.
I’m the man preying upon her daughter in a time of weakness.
I’m the man leveraging his position and her affinity for male authority figures for my own personal gain- and the fact that Makoto is magically happy now doesn’t absolve me of that.
This couldn’t stay hidden forever. Maki was destined to find out the moment she was forced into a more active role in Makoto’s life.
But what does that mean for me?
Do I have to stop now?
Do I have to give up on something and someone I’ve grown so attached to just because her mother is worried?
Can the two of us remain the way we are with Maki indefinitely stuck trying to peer through the brush? Is such a thing possible?
Should I just come clean?
No. Fuck no. Of course not. I’m lucky she doesn’t seem to suspect me in the first place.
What should I do?
What am I supposed to do?
How can I get out of this?
How can I bring myself to care about Maki’s issues when I’m so consumed by my own?
Now, I am the one rotting from the inside out. How am I supposed to circumvent this?
: Sensei?...
: Call me Akira.
scene makiclearnight6
: Akira?...
The answer to my last rhetorical question is the same one I provided just a few short moments ago.
I can get around this by disguising myself as someone better.
I’ll remain disgusting inside of my head- and apply a fresh coat of paint so that those who don’t spend too much time with me mistake me for someone special.
Right now, what I need to do is connect. If I can connect, I can both bring Maki over to my side and start easing her out of these ridiculous worries of hers.
Makoto is smart.
It’s just like I said.
She’s smart and she can make her own decisions.
If she wants a thick, adult cock inside of her, she should be allowed to have one. It’s no different from the ones they sell in the store, right?
It’s not wrong just because it’s attached to me, right? I’m better. I’m getting better. I’m not the same person I was when I started doing this. It’s different now.
It’s different now.
scene makiclearnight7
: How about “Aki-kun” instead? I like that better.
It’s no different now.
I’m the same piece of shit I’ve always been.
And no amount of paint could ever hide that.
: That...
: What’s wrong? Too childish? You embarrassed?
: Just...stick with Akira for now.
scene makiclearnight8
: ...Okay.

: Don’t think I’ll let you off the hook just because you finally gave me your name, though. I still want to know what you think I should do. Like, what you really think. Not what you think I want to hear.
: What if this were Ami we were talking about? What would you say to her if it started to be clear that she was involved with someone?
: I...don’t think I have to worry about that.
: I didn’t think I had to worry about it with Makoto for at least a couple more years, but here we are. Life just moves quicker than we want it to sometimes.
: In fact, it’s so quick that whatever preparations we make along the way can wind up totally worthless once the ball really gets rolling.

: I just want her to be safe. Like, safer than condoms — which I am very proud of her for, by the way. But I want her to be so safe that she just doesn’t have sex ever. That would be cool. No sex means no talk.
: Just have the fucking talk, Maki. It’s better than walking on eggshells every time the subject comes up — which I imagine it does pretty frequently since the two of you work at a porn shop.
scene makiclearnight9
: But what if she takes it the wrong way? I’m finally on her good side and I don’t want it to seem like I’m overbearing or...anything like that.
: Well, what’s more important to you? Making sure your daughter is safe or making sure she likes you?
scene makiclearnight10
: Obviously the first one. I know that. But that doesn’t make it any easier.
: It’s not supposed to be easy. This is what you signed up for when you carried her around inside of you for nine months.
scene makiclearnight11
: It was actually ten. That girl did not want to come out.
: That is information I did not need or want.
: You’re welcome.
: Listen, can we head back in now? I’ve exhausted all I have to say about this and if Makoto finds out I was talking to her mom about her sex life, she’s going to stop helping me out after school.
: “Helping you out after school?” You think I haven’t heard that before? Don’t tell me you’re the one Makoto’s sleeping with, are you?
: Maki-
scene makiclearnight12
: Relax, Aki...ra. I’m obviously joking.
if makisex == True:
: You’re already boning me. Well, when I’m not in desert-mode at least. And you’d be a real idiot to think you can get away with boning my daughter as well.
: Especially since she’s only-
: Yeah, I know. You don’t need to remind me.
scene makiclearnight13
: No...but it doesn’t hurt.
: Can, uhh...
: Can I ask you a personal question? One that doesn’t really have to do with Makoto?
: Please, yes. I’ve been trying to move on from that topic since it came up.
: Then...
: You don’t have to answer this if you don’t want to, but...do you think you’ll ever look for something a little more serious? Romantically, I mean.
: Are you...interested in me like that?
: My husband literally just died.
: That’s exactly why I asked. Because if you’re trying to get me to commit to a relationship right now-
: I just...want to know. That’s all.
: I like what we have now. But I’d also like knowing if this is all it will ever be or...
: If there will ever be room to grow.
: I think we...work kind of well together. And stuff. Whether it be as friends or fuck-buddies or...whatever.
: It’d just be a little comforting knowing you’re not going anywhere. That’s all.
: I don’t really have anyone else anymore.
scene black
: Ask me again when Makoto’s out of high school.
: But if we wait that long, you might start liking her instead! I only have so many years of youthful beauty left!
: I’m going back to the room now, Maki.
: Ah! Wait, no! You can’t leave without me! You have the key!
else:
scene black
: Well, it wasn’t a very good joke...and I’d appreciate it if you didn’t suggest things like that anymore.
: No wonder you didn’t want to sleep with me. You already have the younger model.
: I’m just going to walk away now.
: Ah, wait up! I need you to let me back into the room. I didn’t bring my key.
: You should have thought of that before messing with me.
: Akiraaaaaa!
The two of us make our way back to the room, but I’m slowed down along the way by the weight of a gigantic pit in my stomach.

As Maki climbs into bed with Haruka and I spread out a futon, that pit expands in size- planting itself into the lining of my organs and sprouting what I can only imagine as the ugliest flowers to ever bloom.
As I sleep tonight, I will think of all of the wrong I’ve done.
My sins will go on to create the longest highlight reel one could imagine and I will watch with bated breath as every single unfortunate segment sinks its nails into my irises.
And I will do this because there will always be certain aspects of life that just don’t click for us.
For me, the most glaring issue is letting go and accepting just how weak I really am.
And for Maki, it’s trusting the wrong people.
She should have never let me into her home.
And I know that she’ll regret it one day...
Because, if she doesn’t-
This was all for nothing.
I go to sleep.
And I pause the highlight reel in a room with a deep pink glow.
